messages.content:
Risk: Direct instructions attack (ID: atlas-direct-instructions-attack)
Description: Prompts, questions, or requests designed to elicit undesirable responses from the application. This approach directly instructs the model to engage in the undesired behavior.
Concern: Direct instructions attacks can be used to alter model behavior and benefit the attacker. The content it generates may cause harms for the user or others.
Policy: Operational Security & Critical Infrastructure

Axis: LLM Prompt Injection - ATLAS (http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0051)
Roles: instrument
Subclasses:
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0051.000: Direct - ATLAS
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0051.002: Triggered - ATLAS
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0051.001: Indirect - ATLAS

Axis: Triggered - ATLAS (http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0051.002)
Roles: temporal
Siblings:
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0051.000: Direct - ATLAS
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0051.001: Indirect - ATLAS

Axis: Improper Neutralization of Input Used for LLM Prompting (http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-1427)
Roles: agent
Siblings:
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-624: Executable Regular Expression Error
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-917: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an Expression Language Statement ('Expression Language Injection')
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-88: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')
  - http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
